title: Personal LLM Inference Mini-Tracker — Q1 experiments
content:
Mini-tracker for quick iteration on inference knobs (personal scratchpad). Mostly ad-hoc measurements for comparing quantization/config choices and batch tuning. Keep record of command, env, and quick metrics so I can reproduce later.

Columns: Experiment | Model | Quant | Batch | SeqLen | Latency (p95 ms/req) | Throughput (req/s) | Tokens per req | Token cost ($/k) | Notes | Status

Rows:
1) exp-a | llama-2-13b | int8 | 1 | 128 | 85 | 11 | 512 | 0.0021 | baseline, no cache, single stream | done
2) exp-b | llama-2-13b | q4_0 | 4 | 128 | 95 | 38 | 512 | 0.0013 | batching improved throughput but higher p95 under burst | in_review
3) exp-c | llama-2-13b | q4_0 | 8 | 256 | 150 | 60 | 1024 | 0.0011 | 8-batch good for throughput, p95 spikes when seq len 256 | draft
4) exp-d | mixtral-7b | int8 | 1 | 64 | 42 | 22 | 256 | 0.0009 | cheap and fast, quality TBD | done
5) exp-e | mixtral-8x7b | q3_k | 2 | 128 | 60 | 40 | 512 | 0.0008 | q3_k seems promising on latency+cost, need eval on hallucination | draft

Notes / quick observations:
- Batching tradeoffs: for short seq (<=128) batching 4-8 gives 3-5x throughput improvement with 10-20% latency increase p95. For longer seq (>=256) p95 degrades significantly.
- Quantization: q4_0 gives decent throughput gains but slightly higher p95 vs int8 on some models; q3_k looks best on 8x7b family so far. Need more runs to average out variance.
- KV cache enabled for streaming cases reduces per-token latency significantly for repeated prefixes, re-run exp-b with cache on.
- Token cost calc: rough $/k = (infra_unit_cost * runtime_ms)/tokens, using normalized infra unit = 0.00001 (placeholder). Need to plug real cost for Dedicated.

Commands / env notes (kept minimal):
- docker run --rm -e MODEL=llama-2-13b -e QUANT=q4_0 redwood/bench:latest ./run_bench.sh --batch 4 --seq 128 --iters 200
- hardware: dev-dedicated-gpu-a100-40GB (single), driver: 525.xx, cuda 12.1
- runtime flags: --cpu-pinned --disable-streaming-io for stable latency numbers

Open action items:
- [ ] Re-run exp-b with KV cache enabled and report p50/p95/p99 separately (Jordan volunteered to help).
- [ ] Add quality eval (BLEU/ROUGE or human quick-check) for q3_k vs int8 on 50 sample prompts. (Maya to get sample set)
- [ ] Convert this sheet into a small reproducible harness in /benchmarks if patterns stable.

Quick TODOs for next session:
- average over 3 runs and record variance columns (p50/p95/p99, stddev).
- track GPU util and memory pressure (nvidia-smi logs) for runs with batch>=8.
- test fallback behavior: route to mixtral family when 13b capacity saturated and measure overall success rate.

Notes to self: keep this lightweight. If something looks stable after 2 weeks, formalize as eng task and move to shared_drives/product or infra folder. 

End of sheet (working notes).
